inpop17a-gir.name: INPOP17a G+IR station-only sensitivity
inpop17a-gir.frame: Published fitted coordinates relative to ITRF2005 references; not guaranteed canonical ITRF2005 or matched to the selected EOP frame
inpop17a-gir.selection: Preselected published final G+IR solution; no choice based on the eleven residuals

sources.location: Table 8, printed page 21; J2000 position and velocity, metres and metres/year; APOLLO data end 2016-11-25 in Table 4
Section 9.1.2 specifies TT for linear station velocity; using a Julian year is an explicit interpretation, not restated in the 2017 table

limitations: Station-only sensitivity with DE440 translation, orientation and reflector constants retained; not a matched INPOP or DE440 reduction.
No speculative frame transform; fitted station coordinates need not realize canonical ITRF2005, ITRF2020 or the selected EOP frame.
Tide-free interpretation is supported by regularized coordinates and cited IERS routines, but not explicitly flagged in the 2017 report.
The older cited reduction includes atmospheric and CSR4.0 ocean loading; precise 2017 choices are not restated and are not reproduced here.
Published component uncertainties are retained as metadata only; no full covariance or reference-point metrology recovered.
